# opsolete Provider

Manages Opsolete's platform objects: projects and their environment values, workspaces and their variables, variable sets and VCS connections. Templates on workspaces, runs and team access stay in Opsolete's UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    opsolete = {
      source = "opsolete/opsolete"
    }
  }
}

# A service token: Settings → API tokens in Opsolete, or `opsolete api-token terraform` on the server.
# Or leave both out and set OPSOLETE_URL and OPSOLETE_TOKEN.
provider "opsolete" {
  url   = "https://opsolete.example.com"
  token = var.opsolete_token
}

variable "opsolete_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) A service token (Settings → API tokens, or `opsolete api-token <name>` on the server): admin rights, audited as `token:<name>`. Default: the `OPSOLETE_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `url` (String) Opsolete's address, e.g. `https://opsolete.example.com`. Default: the `OPSOLETE_URL` environment variable.
